sources.title: Visitors
sources.publisher: Embassy of Grenada in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: Grenada's live Embassy visitor page says visa requirements are citizenship-based and actively links its complete country-requirements schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa requirements for travel to Grenada are based on your country of citizenship.

sources.title: Visa Requirements for Traveling to Grenada
sources.publisher: Embassy of Grenada in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: The Embassy's actively linked schedule, updated April 2024, directly names Libya as Prior to Arrival and defines that as consular issuance before travel.

sources.title: Visas to Jordan: nationality table
sources.officialityEvidence: Jordan's official tourism site names Libya as Applicable and says its visa can be obtained on arrival; the same page requires a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Libya Applicable Visa can be obtained upon arrival.

sources.title: Visas
sources.publisher: Embassy of Panama in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: Panama's live Embassy schedule names Libya in the authorized-visa cohort; it says those applicants need an authorized visa and must not travel until granted.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Lebanon, Liberia, Libya, Mali, Mauritania, Morocco, Mozambique, Myanmar, Nepal, Niger

sources.title: Visa Information for Foreigners — Libya
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: Türkiye's live Foreign Ministry nationality schedule divides ordinary Libyan passports by age and confines the electronic route for ages 16–45 to holders of specified third-country visas or residence permits.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ordinary passport holders between the age of 16 and 45 are required to have visa.

sources.title: Suspension of Visa Issuance to Foreign Nationals to Protect the Security of the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: The live State Department PP 10998 notice, updated February 2, 2026, fully suspends Libyan visa issuance, subject to exceptions and valid-visa grandfathering.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Iran, Laos, Libya, Mali, Niger, Sierra Leone, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, and Yemen

sources.title: 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(38), geographical definition of United States
sources.publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House of Representatives
sources.officialityEvidence: The official U.S. Code defines the United States for INA purposes to include Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands and the Northern Mariana Islands.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

policies.title: Libyan ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's current Embassy-linked nationality schedule places Libya in its Prior to Arrival visitor-visa cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Libyan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Prior to Arrival means the visa must be obtained from a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and special-document cases are outside scope.

policies.title: Libyan ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official tourism nationality table marks Libya applicable for a visitor visa obtained on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Libyan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
All non-Jordanians must register on Gateway2Jordan and obtain a QR code before departure.
Final admission and any crossing-specific requirements remain separate.

policies.title: Libyan ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule places Libya in the authorized-visa cohort requiring approval before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Libyan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Embassy says authorization may take up to 60 business days and travellers must not finalize travel until the visa is granted.
The separate third-country-document waiver is not treated as the ordinary-passport baseline.

conflicts.officialStatus: age-conditional ordinary-passport visa exemption and advance-visa requirement; third-country-document-conditioned evisa
conflicts.explanation: Türkiye exempts ordinary Libyan passport holders under 16 or over 45 for tourist visits, requires a visa for ages 16–45, and limits their eVisa route to holders of specified third-country visas or residence permits. This cannot be flattened to unconditional eVisa access.

Current rules fully suspend entry and visa issuance for Libyan nationals, but retain valid-visa grandfathering, specified exceptions and case-by-case national-interest decisions; this cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
The federal suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition includes Puerto Rico. Its exceptions and grandfathering cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
The federal suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition includes Guam. Its exceptions and grandfathering cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.

The federal suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition includes the Northern Mariana Islands. Its exceptions and grandfathering cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.

The federal suspension is an INA entry and visa-issuance rule; the INA geographical definition includes the U.S. Virgin Islands. Its exceptions and grandfathering cannot be flattened to a normal visitor status.
